decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed erection of a mansard roof extension with dormer windows comprising one two-bedroom self-contained flat and one three-bedroom self-contained flat, because of its design, position and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of Bellgrove Mansions. The proposal would accord with the Councils Residential Standards and Controls, and would not be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties or local highway conditions. On balance, the development is in accordance with Unitary Development Plan (December 2003) policies ENV-B.1.1, H.4.1, H.3.3 and IMP.2.2. It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects resulting from this.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The original clay roof-tiles of Bellgrove Mansions shall be re-used in the construction of the mansard roof exetension hereby approved. Where additional tiles are required, samples of the tiles shall be submitted to and improved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the completion of the works.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the flats are occupied.

Condition : 5 - The flats hereby permitted shall not be occupied until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound between the floors and the internal walls of the existing and proposed flats has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 6 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 7 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of  08.00 to 18.00 on Mondays to Friday and 08.00 to 13.00 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a mansard roof extension comprising one 2 bed self contained flat and one 3 bed self contained flat.
